checks.finding: tasks.md T-001–T-004 and T-006 classify secrets, private-data mutation, access control or installation as high; T-005 classifies irreversible deletion as critical, consistent with risk-classification-policy.md.

tasks.md Global constraints require a named independent reviewer and Red→Green evidence for each high/critical task; every Done When repeats these controls, and T-005 additionally requires a signed evidence bundle and distinct named second approver.

tasks.md T-006 Planned Files and Scope combine installer and build integration, protected CI inventory changes, plugin metadata, user documentation, and feature-wide verification addenda. Its Tests require all TEST-001–066 and suffixed cases, while Done When requires full live/native acceptance across the preceding tasks. These exceed three implementation areas and cannot reasonably be completed as one focused task; implementation ownership and completion evidence would be difficult to review as one unit.

The functional scopes in tasks.md T-001–T-005 map to error paths in acceptance-tests.md: AC-016 unsafe storage, AC-015 write failures, AC-005 stale materialization, AC-009/010 lifecycle failures, and AC-013 failed deletion.

SKIP: tasks.md has no standalone test task declaring a unit, integration, end-to-end or acceptance test type; T-006 includes delivery integration and verification rather than a single declared test type.
tasks.md T-001–T-006 each have a Rollback field identifying how capture, recovery, lifecycle registration or scheduling is disabled while expiry protections and owned cleanup are retained.

tasks.md assigns contract/privacy, journal, authority/recovery, adapters, cleanup/scheduler and delivery integration to T-001–T-006 respectively; shared plugin and installer work is ordered by Blockers.

tasks.md Blockers follow the required artifacts: T-001 contracts/privacy precede T-002 journal, T-002 journal precedes T-003 recovery, T-003 recovery/expiry reads precede T-004 adapters and T-005 cleanup, and both feed T-006 delivery integration.
SKIP: no task in tasks.md is explicitly scoped as a bugfix, debugging or incident-remediation task.

findings.finding: tasks.md T-006 combines installer/build integration, protected CI changes, plugin metadata, user documentation and feature-wide live/native verification of all acceptance tests. This exceeds the role's three-area and single-focused-session sizing criteria, making implementation ownership and completion evidence ambiguous.
